commissions_work_item_unique.name: commissions_work_item_unique
commissions_work_item_unique.where: basis = 'WORK_VALUE' AND work_item_id IS NOT NULL

commissions_collected_unique.name: commissions_collected_unique
commissions_collected_unique.where: basis = 'COLLECTED' AND work_item_id IS NOT NULL AND source_voucher_id IS NOT NULL

vouchers_active_commission_payment_uniqu.name: vouchers_active_commission_payment_unique
vouchers_active_commission_payment_uniqu.where: "vouchers"."commission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "vouchers"."type" = 'PAYMENT' AND "vouchers"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "vouchers"."reversal_of_voucher_id" IS NULL

vouchers_receipt_party.name: vouchers_receipt_party
vouchers_receipt_party.value: "vouchers"."type" = 'PAYMENT' OR ("vouchers"."patient_id" IS NOT NULL OR "vouchers"."other_party_name" IS NOT NULL)

vouchers_payment_party.name: vouchers_payment_party
vouchers_payment_party.value: "vouchers"."type" = 'RECEIPT' OR ("vouchers"."doctor_id" IS NOT NULL OR "vouchers"."lab_id" IS NOT NULL OR "vouchers"."supplier_id" IS NOT NULL OR "vouchers"."other_party_name" IS NOT NULL)
